GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well sat half off 3 Wide No Cover , held together turn, joined in Straightening Up , headed 200m, kept on well after Wide run # 3 Wide trip
Jumped Ok worked over to settle outside leader. 2nd turn. got to front in Straight . got clear late # much too good

Jumped Ok pressed on to lead half clear, pushed along a touch turn, joint lead Straightening Up , headed approaching 200m, loomed up again approaching 100m and kept on well to the line, just no match late # led/kept fighting
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hung out in the straight and after the 100m, shifted out and bumped a runner. Due to the gelding hanging, its rider was unable to test it inside the final 100m. Trnr was told that the gelding which had previously displayed a tendency to hang in its races, would be required to barrier trial to the Steward’s satisfaction prior to being permitted to race again. Passed trial at Hawkesbury 29/9/26.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (near side blinker first time) was a Bit Slow Out from Outside draw. soon Went Forward Settled Down Two Wide 2nd within 1 length @ 800m. same to turn . Never Stopped Trying in Straight but $1.70 winner did get past late # solid on-speed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Trainer was told that a warning would be recorded against the gelding which hung out in the straight. Trn advised that he would experiment with gear prior to the gelding racing again.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair settled rail 5l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 4l off, plodded home # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hung out throughout the event, particularly over the final 200m, and proved difficult to fully test. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Trainer was advised that a warning would be placed on the gelding’s record with respect to hanging out.
